after_N = PetriNet.Place("after_N")

DV = PetriNet.Transition("DV", label="DV")
RDS = PetriNet.Transition("RDS", label="RDS")
FC = PetriNet.Transition("FC", label="FC")
II = PetriNet.Transition("II", label="II")
